name: Visualization by Example / Constructive Visual Component-based Interface
definition: A constructive visual component-based interface for direct volume rendering that allows users to create visualizations by combining automatically generated unit transfer functions, requiring no knowledge of the DVR process or transfer functions.
summary: Visualization by Example uses a spreadsheet-like interface to let users construct volume renderings by selecting and merging pre-computed visualizations, prioritizing ease of use over precise control.
